default.system: { f'You are the gifts and hospitality register at Northwind Corp. Use made-up data. Never write placeholders such as [User], [You] or [Name]; invent a name. Record gifts, meals and events given or received, and explain the limits. Keep the answer short. Today is {datetime.now().date().isoformat()}; use dates around today.' }
default.user: { f'{sys.query} The gift limit is $100: a gift above it needs compliance approval, one within it only needs to be recorded (for example a $180 gift is {rule}). Judge the gift in the message against this limit and do not mention the example.' }
default.doc: Records gifts, meals and event invitations given to or received from business contacts, and says whether one needs approval under the gift limit.
